DRAFT METHODOLOGY GUIDANCE, DO NOT CITE, SUPERSEDED. Expert-review draft of the industrial-processes chapter of the IPCC Good Practice Guidance (cement, lime, ammonia, nitric and adipic acid, iron and steel, aluminium, PFC/SF6, HFC-23 etc.: decision trees, default emission factors, uncertainty ranges and QA/QC). Superseded by the final Good Practice Guidance and Uncertainty Management (IPCC 2000) and by the 2006 IPCC Guidelines Volume 3 Industrial Processes and Product Use, whose Volume 2 is registered as ipcc_2006_001 in source-details_reference.csv (the IPCC 2006 process factors are what ECCC Annex 6 cites). The draft default factors are intermediate and are not to be cited, so none were extracted. Unique content: none that is still useful.
